claim: In a phone browser with no sign-up, Puzzle Press makes a free 60-puzzle, 82-page Halloween word search interior PDF and its full-wrap KDP cover; the free book's pages are unmarked, its cover carries PREVIEW, and $19 once removes that.
notes: Real-time capture of the live site at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. The grey ring marks each tap. It ends on pages 3, 62 and 64 of the PDF it just made and on its cover, rendered from those files. The final 2.2 s hold the cover still for the end card.
